This trial in Phase 1 is investigating the use of zanubrutinib, fluconazole, diltiazem, voriconazole, and clarithromycin in patients with B-cell malignancies who have relapsed or refractory disease, with specific eligibility criteria including confirmed CLL/SLL, MCL, WM, or MZL, and exclusion criteria such as hypersensitivity to the drugs or prior exposure to zanubrutinib.

This phase I trial is investigating the pharmacokinetics of dfd-29 (minocycline) in healthy adult males and postmenopausal females, with specific eligibility criteria related to postmenopausal status, contraceptive use, BMI, smoking history, and absence of certain medical conditions, while excluding individuals with hypersensitivity reactions to minocycline, significant diseases affecting drug metabolism, abnormal lab values, recent immunizations, alcohol/drug abuse, and recent blood donations.

This phase I trial is investigating the effects of cenobamate on healthy individuals aged 18 to 50, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria related to health status, medication history, and lifestyle habits.

This trial for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer is testing the efficacy of docetaxel micellar in patients meeting specific eligibility criteria, including histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate, ongoing use of GnRH agonist or antagonist, and adequate bone marrow, hepatic, and renal function, among others, with exclusion criteria such as prior chemotherapy with docetaxel, uncontrolled cardiovascular disease, and certain infections.

This trial in Phase 1 is investigating the use of oral and transdermal menopausal hormone therapy in women aged 45 to 59 with specific menopausal conditions, excluding those with contraindications such as bleeding disorders, cancer, and thromboembolism, among others.
